text:
ria: PTAL — addressed all comments from @samir and @tj. Squashed commits and added a small e2e to cover the fallback path. CI passed locally but GH Actions shows a flaky run. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321

samir: thanks, will take a look in the morning. quick Q — any behavioral change that needs customers called out?

tj: skimmed the diff, looks small. can you paste the retry config you changed?

ria: sure — `retries: 2` in runtime/config.yaml; added a unit + e2e for the fallback behaviour.

ci-bot: GH Actions job #4321 failed on macOS-latest: network timeout on integration/test_kv_cache (flaky)

marta: rerunning the workflow now.

ci-bot: Re-run queued by marta — run 4321.1

samir: also — did you add an Unreleased changelog entry?

ria: yes, under `Unreleased -> runtime`: 'fallback: reduce retries to 2 to avoid cascading latency spikes'

tj: LGTM. plan: merge once CI is green, schedule canary at 16:00 PT. @ops can you reserve that slot?

ops: noted, reserving canary window 16:00 PT in release-ops. Will monitor.

marta: CI green now :thumbsup: — all tests passed on run 4321.1

tj: ok merging in 5. will tag canary and kick off smoke tests.

ria: huge thanks! ping me if any fallout during canary.

samir: nice. can you also add a short note in the PR describing the rollback signal we should watch for?

ria: done — added a short section `Fallback health signals` with the metrics and alert thresholds.

tj: merged and pushed canary tag `v0.23.1-canary.7` :tada:

ops: canary deployed to cluster `canary-2`. I'll loop back in an hour with metrics.

marta: monitoring dashboard looks stable so far.

ria: thanks everyone, closing the follow-up thread.
